capabilities: Pin, hide, and sort property name suggestions, including wildcard rules
Configure per-property value suggestions with custom preset candidates
Reorder list values in Properties by dragging or command
Move list values between properties in the same note
Choose list format (preserve, bracket, or one per line) after reordering
disambiguation: Despite its name, it does not rearrange property fields in a note; it manages suggestion menus and the order of list values.
extras: Requires Obsidian 1.12.7 or later, desktop or mobile. Works locally with no account or remote calls; value dragging only supports top-level YAML text lists, and type-mismatched values may become strings. The directory listing notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian's native property suggestions offer little control over which names and values appear and in what order, and list values in Properties cannot be rearranged.
summary: Property-suggestion customizer that pins, hides, and sorts property name and value suggestions, and reorders YAML list values in Obsidian Properties.
